metadata.question: Was the vegetation health (NDVI) in Namibia worse in February 21-28 2019, compared to the long-term average for the same month period from 2003 to 2017?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Location: Namibia (need to define a geometry) - Time periods: * Current: February 21-28, 2019 * Baseline: February 21-28 for each year 2003-2017 (15 years) - Data: MODIS NDVI (MOD13Q1.006) would be good for long-term analysis - Band: 'NDVI' 2. Masking strategy: - MODIS NDVI has quality bands, but for simplicity I'll use the NDVI band directly - Need to handle potential cloud/quality issues 3. Logic: - Calculate mean NDVI for 2019 period - Calculate mean NDVI for baseline period (2003-2017) - Compare if 2019 NDVI < baseline mean NDVI - Need to check for empty collections and valid pixels Steps: 1. Define Namibia geometry (I'll use a rough bounding box) 2. Get MODIS NDVI collection for both periods 3. Check collection sizes 4. Calculate mean NDVI for each period 5. Validate results (not None, within reasonable range -1 to 1) 6. Compare and output answer ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const namibia = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([11.7, -28.9, 25.3, -16.9]); // Time periods const currentStart = '2019-02-21'; const currentEnd = '2019-02-28'; const baselineStart = '2003-02-21'; const baselineEnd = '2017-02-28'; // 2. Data Acquisition const modisCol = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MOD13Q1') .select('NDVI'); // Current period (2019) const currentCol = modisCol .filterDate(currentStart, currentEnd) .filterBounds(namibia); // Baseline period (2003-2017, Feb 21-28 each year) const baselineCol = modisCol .filterDate(baselineStart, baselineEnd) .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(51, 58, 'day_of_year')) // Feb 21-28 .filterBounds(namibia); // Check collection sizes const currentSize = currentCol.size().getInfo(); const baselineSize = baselineCol.size().getInfo(); console.log(`2019 Images: ${currentSize}, Baseline Images: ${baselineSize}`); if (currentSize === 0 || baselineSize === 0) { console.log("C1"); return; } // 3. Processing - Calculate mean NDVI const currentNdvi = currentCol.mean(); const baselineNdvi = baselineCol.mean(); // Get pixel counts to check for valid data const currentCount = currentNdvi.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: namibia, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDVI').getInfo(); const baselineCount = baselineNdvi.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: namibia, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDVI').getInfo(); console.log(`Valid pixels - Current: ${currentCount}, Baseline: ${baselineCount}`); if (currentCount === 0 || baselineCount === 0) { console.log("C2"); return; } // Calculate mean NDVI values const currentMean = currentNdvi.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: namibia, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDVI').getInfo(); const baselineMean = baselineNdvi.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: namibia, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDVI').getInfo(); console.log(`NDVI - Current: ${currentMean?.toFixed(4)}, Baseline: ${baselineMean?.toFixed(4)}`); // 4. Validation & Final Answer if (currentMean === null || baselineMean === null || isNaN(currentMean) || isNaN(baselineMean) || currentMean < -1 || currentMean > 1 || baselineMean < -1 || baselineMean > 1) { console.log("C3"); } else if (currentMean < baselineMean) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
